entries.reason: Production leaves sign-in off, and a sign-in writes to production auth.
Only a signed-in viewer can open the Account screen, and journeys test a signed-out viewer.
Signed-in My Watch needs a sign-in, and journeys test a signed-out viewer.
Recommendations are off in the test build, because they cannot work without writes.
An inserted hero slide has a button that opens a jesusfilm.org page in the browser, and that page sends production web analytics. The journey swipes past it and never taps it (KTD12).
The "Become a beta tester" card in the Home mission rail opens the beta signup page in the browser. The journey asserts that the card shows and never taps it (KTD12).
The "Become a beta tester" button on the Mission screen opens the beta signup page in the browser. The journey asserts that the button shows and never taps it (KTD12).
A 5-second hold on "Become a beta tester" shows the push test ID alert. A hold that ends early opens the beta signup page in the browser, so no journey holds the button.
Simulators and emulators have no cast receiver, so the cast dialog finds no device. The dialog's help links open web pages, so no journey opens it.
The AirPlay picker is a system view, and the simulator has no AirPlay receiver.
The picture-in-picture window is a system window outside the app, and a journey cannot assert it. An iPhone simulator also reports picture-in-picture as not supported.
On iOS, Maestro 2.11.0 does not read the controls on the right half of a landscape screen, so a journey cannot leave fullscreen. The play-video journey checks fullscreen on Android.
The "Resume at" offer shows only when Explore's "Keep watching" opens a video that has a later saved place. Only a signed-in viewer has a saved place (R10), and the test settings hide Explore.
The share-video journey opens the system share sheet and cancels it. A share to a target sends the video link out of the device.
